title: OTX and abuse.ch manual pivots (batch p1-G07-1: otx, otx_keyless, abusech)
notes: Manual follow-up pages of the OTX and abuse.ch modules (P153 cond 2, P156 cond 9: shown with the single no-key coverage line). Search and report pages only; nothing here submits, uploads or downloads samples. Checked 2026-11-26 from a datacenter egress: OTX pages answer 200 (single-page app, content rendered by JavaScript); abuse.ch browse pages redirect non-browser clients to /verify-ua/ (a browser check), so they are manual links only.
